messages:
elaine: FYI Tom's I-9 flagged — passport valid but mailing address on offer differs from bank statement. Tom's remote (NZ, +12) and Day 1 Tue. Can we accept utility bill + virtual notary?

 tom: Yes I have a power bill and can do an online notary Thu 10am NZT. Also need laptop shipped to my work address; concierge available 9-5.

 ops-bot: Background check: identity pending. Criminal screen cleared. Identity verification timeout 72h.

 elaine: We'll accept primary passport + secondary utility bill + mobile notary cert. Need manager sign-off for address change. I'll DM hiring manager now.

 it-kickoff: IT note: If notary cert received by Fri EOD we can ship Mon for Tue arrival. Preference: signature required. Confirm shipping address recipient name.

 tom: Ship to my full name as on passport. Signature required. I've booked notary Thu 10 NZT and uploaded docs to the secure intake link.

 elaine: Manager approved address exception. Once notary cert posted, I'll mark ID verified and trigger badge courier and laptop ship. Reminder: benefits enroll opens Day 1; you have 30 days.

 ops-bot: Reminder: upload notary cert within 48h to avoid delay.

 it-kickoff: I'll prepare laptop image and send pre-ship checklist by email.

 elaine: Thanks team — tracking here. Tom, welcome aboard! :tada:
